stops.name: Lago di Calvaresc
stops.quote: Parco Val Calanca is the smallest nature reserve in Switzerland, but has a big heart – just like the heart-shaped Lago di Calvaresc, whose distinctive shape is reflected in its logo.
stops.english: Parco Val Calanca is the smallest nature reserve in Switzerland, but has a big heart – just like the heart-shaped Lake Calvaresc, whose distinctive shape is reflected in its logo.
